bullets: Define the vision, strategy, and roadmap for platform capabilities that span multiple areas, and explain how they fit together into one platform story.
Build tools that let customers, partners, and Customer Experience teams make large-scale data and configuration changes safely, auditably, and without engineering help.
Enable AI to make implementation work self-service: guided workflows, AI-assisted bulk changes, and validation that catches problems before they reach a live workflow.
Treat internal teams as customers. Work with implementation, support, and partner teams to find the highest-cost manual work, streamline workflows, and drive operational…
Drive adoption of shared platform patterns across product teams, building alignment through clarity, evidence, and relationships rather than mandate.
